POS Shabu

A point-of-sale and management system for a shabu restaurant: in-store sales, table reservations and QR-code ordering. I did the system analysis and built the backend.

Overview

A shabu restaurant needs one system that runs the whole shift: customers order from a QR code at their table, staff manage reservations and table status, the kitchen sees orders as they come in, and the cashier settles the bill and prints a receipt. This project built that system end to end as a Next.js web application on a MySQL database.

My part

I was responsible for the system analysis and the backend:

  • Gathered and documented the functional requirements for ordering, table management, inventory, staff management and payments.
  • Modelled the system with Use Case, Sequence and Class diagrams.
  • Turned the models into a MySQL database design and a REST API specification, then implemented the API in Next.js.
  • Tested every workflow in Postman against the documented requirements.

What the system does

  • Customer side: log in, browse the menu and order from a QR code, with ingredient customisation.
  • Reservations with table-status tracking.
  • Staff dashboard for the kitchen, reservations and tables.
  • Inventory and stock management with import/export.
  • Payment and receipt generation.
  • Admin screens for employee management.

Tools

Next.js and TypeScript for the app, Prisma ORM on MySQL for data, Tailwind CSS for the interface, and Postman for API testing.
